conditions.label: other neoplasms of the brain

modalities.evidence: multiparametric MR images (mpMRI), specifically T1, T1 CE, T2, and T2 FLAIR

output.population: 95 patients diagnosed with glioma and 51 patients diagnosed with other neoplasms of the brain, scanned pre-operatively at six diagnostic centers in Nigeria between January 2010 and December 2022.
output.summary: Curated African brain tumor MRI collection: retrospective pre-operative multiparametric scans from six Nigerian diagnostic centers, pre-processed with the BraTS protocol, with expert-annotated tumor subregion labels and a metadata file of study location and scanner type.
